blocks.source: そろそろバグ修正も落ち着いてきたので当分の間、このブログは充電のため『やや低空飛行』にします。ネットにかける時間を減らしたいので、コメント欄も閉じてます。サーセン。
blocks.translation: Now that the bug fixes have more or less settled down, this blog will be “flying rather low” for a while so I can recharge. I want to reduce the amount of time I spend online, so I’ve also closed the comment section. Sorry ‘bout that.

blocks.source: 真っ白に燃え尽きたというより、元々からしてミスティックスター公開のためのブログです。半年経って予定通りといったところです。ご心配には及びません。
blocks.translation: It’s not that I’ve burned out completely. This blog was originally created to announce Mystic Star, after all. It’s been six months, so things have gone more or less according to plan. There’s no need to worry.

blocks.source: もっとも、単に「ネットにかける時間を減らしたい」という程度であって、それ以上でもそれ以下でもありません。なので、普通にメールも届きますし、バグとかあったら対応できます。今までやっていたように、マメにチェックする余裕があるかはちょっと分かりませんが。
blocks.translation: That said, all I mean is simply that I want to reduce the amount of time I spend online—nothing more and nothing less. So I’ll still receive emails as usual and can deal with any bugs that come up. I’m just not sure whether I’ll have the time to check them as diligently as I have until now.

blocks.source: 『やや低空飛行』といった通りなので、記事の更新もたまにはやるつもりです。というより、次の作品まで相当に期間が空くでしょうし、仕事に時間も取られますので。マメに更新しようにもネタも時間もないというだけだったりします。
blocks.translation: As I said, I’ll be “flying rather low,” so I do plan to update the articles occasionally. Besides, there will probably be quite a long gap before the next project, and work takes up time as well. It’s really just that I don’t have either the material or the time to update frequently.

blocks.source: 一応、以下は手を付けようかなと思っています。
blocks.translation: For now, I’m thinking I might work on the following:

blocks.source: 【最低限の攻略ＱＡ】まさしく最低限ながらどこかにまとめておこうと思います。「研究都市のイベントってどこ行けば？」とか「ジャボック博士ってどう倒すの？」とか、頻出質問の回答ぐらいは欲しいかなと。
blocks.translation: [Bare-Minimum Strategy Q&A] I’d like to compile at least the bare minimum somewhere. Things like “Where do I go for the Research City event?” and “How do I defeat Dr. Jabock?”—I think it would be useful to have answers to frequently asked questions like those.

blocks.source: 【作曲講座】やると宣言していたので。……実は途中まで作っていて後一押しです。
blocks.translation: [Music Composition Guide] I said I would do one. …Actually, I’ve already started it and am just one final push away from finishing.

blocks.source: 【ＲＰＧレビュー】このところ市販ＲＰＧをやりまくっているので、気が向けばまとめます。目指せ１００作！ですかね。
blocks.translation: [RPG Reviews] I’ve been playing a lot of commercially released RPGs lately, so I may compile some reviews if I feel like it. The goal is 100 games! I suppose.

blocks.source: 【ＲＰＧ制作講座】もう十分できた気がしないでもないですが、今作での収穫・反省点とか、また追加してもよいかもしれません。既存の講座についても内容を確定せず、読みやすいように手を加えたいところもありますし。これも気が向けば。
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] I feel like I may have already done enough, but I might add some of the lessons learned and points for reflection from this project. I also have parts of the existing guides that I’d like to revise for readability without finalizing the content. This one too, if I feel like it.

blocks.source: 次の作品についても、何か情報を出せればよいのですが……
blocks.translation: I wish I could share some information about the next project as well, but…

blocks.source: 何の開発ツールにしようか？
blocks.translation: What development tool should I use?

blocks.source: いっそプログラムでも組んでみようか？
blocks.translation: Maybe I should try writing a program from scratch?

blocks.source: 一度、小説でも書いてストーリーの練習でもしてみようか？
blocks.translation: Maybe I should try writing a novel to practice storytelling?

blocks.source: ペンタブ買ったし、キャラデザでもしてみようか？
blocks.translation: I bought a pen tablet, so maybe I should try designing some characters?

blocks.source: ……なんて具合で、まだまだです。精々、世界設定とストーリーだけは多少考えているといった程度です。
blocks.translation: …That’s more or less where things stand, so I still have a long way to go. At most, I’ve given some thought to the world-building and story.

blocks.source: ともかく、あえてしばらくは優柔不断に色々やってみようと考えています。一プレイヤーとして他の人の作品もやりたいですし。読書もたくさんして引き出しを増やしたいと思います。ちなみに今年は目指せ２００冊読破！です。
blocks.translation: In any case, I’ve decided to deliberately spend some time trying various things without committing to a particular direction. I also want to play other people’s games as a player. I’d like to read a lot, too, and expand my creative repertoire. By the way, my goal for this year is to read 200 books!

blocks.source: 何にせよ、かなり具体化するまでは、表にはあまり情報を出さないだろうなと思います。長期戦は気楽にやるに限るというのもありますので。忘れた頃に何か出してくるかもしれません。
blocks.translation: In any event, I don’t think I’ll share much information publicly until things have taken fairly concrete shape. Long-term projects are best approached casually, after all. I may reveal something once everyone has forgotten about it.

blocks.source: そんなわけで、不定期でかなり適当な更新になること間違いなしです。でも、時々は更新すると思いますので、今後ともよろしくお願いします。
blocks.translation: So, there’s no doubt that updates will be irregular and fairly haphazard. But I expect to post from time to time, so I hope you’ll continue to follow along.
